name: Osa-AK: the command net jammed (EM radars and radio; the NPC commander runs the crew)
description: A fictional practice shoot against communications jamming (roadmap 7.8, E4). The PU-12 is to give its designations on its net, on 38.550 MHz, but at 60 s a stand-off barrage jammer comes up on the VHF band and the net is lost: the commander hears nothing, waits out the silence (five of the PU-12's one-minute plots), and changes to the early-warning radar site's net, which is on 25.375 MHz below the jammer's band. Its designations bring the drone in; the crew takes it on its own radar and fires. Take any seat.
notes: Fictional. Flat plain. The drone, the two sites' places and the jammer (generic_vhf_barrage in data/em/generic.json: 30-70 MHz, 1 kW) are PLACEHOLDERS. The R-123M's link budget is data/em/osa_ak.json's (15 km with the radars off, 12 km on: mon_2112_80 p12-13), so both sites stand within 10 km.

jammers.notes: A stand-off communications jammer barraging 30-70 MHz from 60 s.
